summary: Backend-only verification for FrameForge agent v0.8.0 anti-UAC fix. critical_code_review_comments: Anti-UAC design is solid: allow_elevation=not _args.uri ensures URI-initiated launches from web buttons never elevate.
Anti-downgrade marker in launcher.vbs (## target=path|version=x.y.z) prevents older exe from hijacking protocol registration.
HKCU AppCompatFlags\Layers RUNASADMIN self-heal on startup addresses the hidden root cause identified in the user report.
Manifest correctly asInvoker with no requireAdministrator string.
